_note: Tier 2 batch w01, 29-31 December 2025. The cartel and mafia turf-war material runs through the whole 29 December stream.

mentions.claim_text: He says what is about to be seen in the news is shocking and matches what they have been saying is coming.
mentions.quote: what you're about to see in the news is pretty shocking
mentions.falsify_match: News items matching prior words, which is the standing claim of the channel.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable as stated: no item is named here.

mentions.claim_text: Heightened security in New York and National Guard deployment to New Orleans for New Year's Eve, which he says is another city he was shown.
mentions.quote: National Guard deploys to New Orleans
mentions.falsify_match: An incident in one of the named cities over New Year.

mentions.claim_text: The attention is on the crown jewel city, but the plan is to infiltrate elsewhere, with a humbling that brings the nation to its knees.
mentions.quote: they are planning to infilt
mentions.falsify_match: An attack lands away from the expected cities.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing lands, or it lands where expected.

mentions.claim_text: Rather than New York and Washington the threat is scattered across the land, with Albuquerque, San Antonio, Oklahoma City and Kansas named.
mentions.quote: I saw Albuquerque, New Mexico. I saw uh San Antonio, Texas
mentions.falsify_match: An attack in one of the named smaller cities rather than in New York or Washington.
mentions.falsify_miss: No attack in any of them.

mentions.claim_text: As Moses was hidden in the cliff of the rock while the glory passed, he says the remnant will be sheltered.
mentions.quote: I sheltered Moses and I will shelter my remnant
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a promise of shelter over an unnamed remnant.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is not there to cause fear but to prepare, answering the charge that he tries to scare people.
mentions.quote: I'm not here to cause you to fear. I'm here to prepare you
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a statement about his own intent.

mentions.claim_text: The remnant protected and a shaking to awakening for a major revival, which he says shook him as he received it.
mentions.quote: I saw a shaking to awakening like you would not believe
mentions.falsify_match: A widely recognised revival following a national shaking.

mentions.claim_text: A stiff-necked people whose heads are bowed low afterwards in humility, with America named the crown jewel of the world after Israel.
mentions.quote: I saw their head bowed down before the father in humility
mentions.falsify_match: A national reversal severe enough to be described as a humbling, followed by a turn to religion.

mentions.claim_text: Mass chaos and confusion on the land and a great humbling coming, because the nation has turned its nose up at the protection given it.
mentions.quote: a great humbling is coming upon the land
mentions.falsify_match: A national event severe enough to be read as a humbling.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether the nation will turn its back while grieving, and reports that what is about to take place will grieve the Lord greatly.
mentions.quote: It will grieve me greatly
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: grief in the spirit has no observable test.

mentions.claim_text: Woe pronounced over New York as a stench before the Father, with prayer over Oklahoma and Texas alongside.
mentions.quote: Woe to you, New York. It's a stench before the father
mentions.falsify_match: A judgment event falling on New York.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer of thanks for America and for the president's protection as the year closes.
mentions.quote: We thank you for President Trump
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: he survives, which is credited to the prayer.

mentions.claim_text: Federal authorities put Minnesota fraud at nine billion dollars or more, with the state administration responding.
mentions.quote: fraud in Minnesota could total $9 billion or more
mentions.falsify_match: Minnesota fraud losses confirmed at that order of magnitude.
mentions.falsify_miss: The figure is revised far downward.

mentions.claim_text: An investigative reporter documenting Minnesota corruption, which he says matches a word given on the 11th.
mentions.quote: doing investigative reporting about all the corruption in Minn
mentions.falsify_match: Further Minnesota corruption exposed after the reporting.
mentions.falsify_miss: The reporting is not borne out.

mentions.claim_text: Named commentators are losing their grip, and control of the media means control of health through food.
mentions.quote: if they control your media, they control your
mentions.falsify_match: Media consolidation visibly used to shape food and health policy.

mentions.claim_text: The Ukrainian leader is removed forcefully and a new pro-Russia, pro-Ukraine government divides the land, giving Russia what it holds.
mentions.quote: be removed forcefully and a new government be set up in Ukraine
mentions.falsify_match: Forcible removal of the Ukrainian leader and a partition settlement.
mentions.falsify_miss: He leaves by election or stays, with no partition.

mentions.claim_text: It all comes to one world with the digital dollar, which he says is what was foretold for the end times.
mentions.quote: going to come to a one world uh with the with the digital dollar
mentions.falsify_match: A single global digital currency is adopted.

mentions.claim_text: Territorial wars named, with the Mexican cartel and the mafia set against each other, and actual family names given to him in prayer.
mentions.quote: the Lord said territorial uh wars
mentions.falsify_match: Open conflict between Mexican cartels and Italian-American organised crime inside the US.

mentions.claim_text: Men behind tables saying this is just business, whom he was allowed to watch and hear, with the Lord saying he is warning of what is coming.
mentions.quote: them say behind tables, this is just business
mentions.falsify_match: An organised-crime decision of that kind surfaces publicly.

mentions.claim_text: He sees this in Chicago, Boston, New Orleans and heavily in New York, hearing Sicily and Little Italy, against a Sharia law element.
mentions.quote: I saw this in Chicago. I saw this in Boston
mentions.falsify_match: Organised-crime conflict surfacing in those named cities.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer for the safety, protection and boldness of a young woman he declines to describe further.
mentions.quote: we pray for that for her safety and her protection
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an unnamed private individual.

mentions.claim_text: The head of the Venezuelan cartel seen as a worm wrapped around and controlled, and the Mexican president likewise wrapped around the cartel.
mentions.quote: he was a worm that was wrapped around
mentions.falsify_match: Evidence that both leaders are controlled by cartel interests.

mentions.claim_text: A red alert given over Iran, which he says was shown regrouping and getting ready.
mentions.quote: red alert
mentions.falsify_match: Iran reconstitutes its capability and moves again.

mentions.claim_text: Iran rebuilding nuclear and military capabilities while its leadership talks defiantly, which he reads as the regrouping he was shown.
mentions.quote: this is what the Lord showed us was a regrouping
mentions.falsify_match: Verified Iranian rebuilding of nuclear and military capability.

mentions.claim_text: The Israeli prime minister heading to America to meet the president this week, read as part of the same sequence.
mentions.quote: Benjamin is headed to America to talk uh to President Trump
mentions.falsify_match: A decision on Iran emerging from that meeting.

mentions.claim_text: A pro-Russia, pro-Ukraine proxy government coming in, described as a fork in the road that could go either way.
mentions.quote: Proxy proxy government
mentions.falsify_match: A proxy government installed in Kyiv.

mentions.claim_text: A girl of three or four seen, identified to him as an anchor baby, in the material about the cartels.
mentions.quote: She was an anchor baby is what they would call him
mentions.falsify_match: A child in that situation becomes publicly identifiable in the cartel material.

mentions.claim_text: Devices built into a water bottle and into shoes rather than backpacks or vests, funded through Iran, described as a level up.
mentions.quote: This was something that was out of a water bottle. shoes
mentions.falsify_match: An attack using a device concealed in a bottle or footwear, traced to Iranian funding.

mentions.claim_text: Not terrorism but an act of war on American soil, with England seen as Iran declares.
mentions.quote: This is an actual act of war within your soil
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on US soil attributed to a state rather than to a group.

mentions.claim_text: He matches the colours on screen to the vision, and describes a lion with its mouth open above a doorway with the house on fire.
mentions.quote: They're all in there just like I saw in the vision
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an uninterpreted image matched to a picture on air.

mentions.claim_text: He asks what the origin of Winnie the Pooh and Christopher Robin is, saying he is still studying it out.
mentions.quote: What is the origin of uh Winnie the Pooh
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a question asked on air with no claim attached.

mentions.claim_text: A heightened alert over Israel, where the danger is not rockets but an enemy within who is already communicating.
mentions.quote: we're looking for it to be with rockets, but it's an enemy within
mentions.falsify_match: An internal attack in Israel rather than a rocket attack.

mentions.claim_text: Venezuela talking to Iran and funding money there, with the cartel heavily influencing Venezuela.
mentions.quote: I see Venezuela talking to Iran
mentions.falsify_match: A Venezuela-Iran financial channel is documented.

mentions.claim_text: Stacks of hundred dollar bills on pallets wrapped in cellophane, which he puts at about a billion dollars.
mentions.quote: $100 bills and pallets
mentions.falsify_match: A cash seizure of that order in the cartel material.

mentions.claim_text: Sicily connected to what he sees in Miami, which he says the Lord separated from the other thread.
mentions.quote: Sicily is connected to what you're seeing in Miami
mentions.falsify_match: An organised-crime link between Sicily and Miami surfaces.

mentions.claim_text: He paces himself to keep receiving, saying the material concerns the Red Dawn experience.
mentions.quote: it's concerning the Red Dawn experi
mentions.falsify_match: A surprise attack of the kind he calls Red Dawn.

mentions.claim_text: A different cartel from the one coming up through Texas and New Mexico, dealing in powder rather than the other trade.
mentions.quote: this is a totally different cartel
mentions.falsify_match: Two distinct cartel networks identified operating on different routes and products.

mentions.claim_text: A lone wolf in Canada attempting machete attacks at petrol stations.
mentions.quote: I see lone wolf in like and I'm I'm in Canada right now
mentions.falsify_match: A bladed lone-attacker incident at a Canadian petrol station.

mentions.claim_text: A clash coming on two fronts, described as territorial wars, with New York named.
mentions.quote: I hear territorial wars in in New York
mentions.falsify_match: Open territorial conflict between criminal groups in New York.

mentions.claim_text: Something about a name attached to a bad actor going around, with the Mexican mafia distinguished from the other group.
mentions.quote: It's something about a name
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a name he does not give.

mentions.claim_text: He reads the material as turf wars rather than trade wars, one side more American than the other.
mentions.quote: This is going to be concerning turf wars
mentions.falsify_match: The conflict is reported as territorial rather than commercial.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is reported as commercial or does not occur.

mentions.claim_text: One side will look like the good guys, almost freedom fighters fighting for America, but it is a turf war.
mentions.quote: they will look like the good guys
mentions.falsify_match: A criminal group is publicly cast as defending America.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer over the girl he names Lily and over the cartels, the Mexican mafia and Cuba, that they come to Christ.
mentions.quote: And I pray over Lily tonight
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: prayer over an unnamed private individual and over criminal groups.

mentions.claim_text: He says praying for the girl because of her father has taken him somewhere he needs a moment to absorb.
mentions.quote: praying from that girl uh because of her father
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an unnamed private individual.

mentions.claim_text: More pieces given about Iran and the Red Dawn, which he says he has been praying over for more than a year.
mentions.quote: I've been praying over Red Dawn for going on two years
mentions.falsify_match: A surprise attack of the Red Dawn kind, traced to Iran.
